PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and glycaemic control"

PHASES

      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Cardio & Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 20m rpe 6

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    - Moderate calorie deficit: 20% below maintenance (estimate TDEE, subtract 20%)
  MACRONUTRIENTS:
    - Protein: 1.6g per kg bodyweight per day
    - Carbohydrate: 3-4g per kg bodyweight per day, distributed evenly across meals
    - Fat: balance remainder of calories, focus on unsaturated fats
  MEAL STRUCTURE:
    - 3 main meals + 1-2 snacks daily
    - Each meal to include lean protein, high-fibre vegetables, and a moderate portion of low-GI carbohydrates (e.g. oats, quinoa, brown rice, sweet potato, legumes)
    - Avoid added sugars and refined grains
    - Include healthy fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts in moderation)
    - Emphasize non-starchy vegetables (broccoli, spinach, peppers, etc.)
    - Limit fruit to 1-2 servings/day, preferably whole fruit
    - Hydration: at least 2L water daily
  GLYCAEMIC CONTROL:
    - Distribute carbohydrate intake evenly across meals/snacks
    - Pair carbohydrates with protein and fibre to reduce glycaemic spikes
    - Avoid sugar-sweetened beverages
    - Monitor blood glucose before and after exercise, adjust carbohydrate intake if needed
    - Do not skip meals; avoid prolonged fasting
    - If hypoglycaemia symptoms occur, consume 15g fast-acting carbohydrate and recheck in 15 minutes
  SUPPLEMENTS:
    - Consider vitamin D and omega-3 if dietary intake is insufficient (consult with healthcare provider)
  SPECIAL NOTES:
    - Coordinate meal timing with metformin dosing as advised by healthcare provider
    - Review nutrition plan with registered dietitian for individualization and safety
